title: Prove paired Dn basis-shear floor for every fitting pairing
body:
## Summary

Prove a sharp obstruction answering the elementary-basis-shear step in ywz65's #2536 Open next question 1. For every paired Dn puncture, every rational basis change across one fixed coordinate split retains minimum algebraic COPY cost equal to the number of live roots, even when all fitting directed binary pairings are optimized jointly.

```text
retain e_i+e_j and e_i-e_j for every graph edge
N has rows in A, columns in its complement D; all other entries zero
P = R(I+N), Q = R(I-N^T), P Q^T = R R^T
every fitting B: cost >= sum_j degree(j) = 2|E|
one fixed pairing B_* = blockdiag(J_2): equality
```

Claim type: scoped mathematical proof with finite exact corroboration. The new identity-minor argument permits paired edge deletions and asymmetric fitting pairings. Single shears and finite products of shears across the same fixed split are included. The first D5 single-shear fixture costs 12 for 12 live roots. Research stopped at this result.

This package was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit ywz65 #2536 for the coordinate-pairing theorem and open basis question; Aaron Wang / navinor #2272/#2518 for root conventions and screens; DreamingOfClouds #2125/#2277 and the retained model lineage; ywz65 #2719 for the distinct full-Dn fixed-dense-pairing theorem. DreamingOfClouds #3045 already covers the full-D4 arbitrary-basis subcase, which is not claimed as new here. Predecessor results are cited rather than re-audited. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

- Before: #2536 leaves changed bases with jointly optimized fitting pairings open and suggests a single elementary shear as the first step.
- After: the written proof gives a forced degree-sized identity minor in every term and an explicit common attaining pairing, for every rational coefficient and every paired graph in the stated basis family.
- Exact local checks pass 439 Gram factorizations, 15,451 pairing bills and 55,490 term minors. Complete small cases use independent elimination and cardinality-of-span rank oracles. Larger rational fixtures are samples, not complete basis censuses.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized registered commands pass locally on CPython 3.12.15, in 0.338 and 0.336 seconds respectively. The registered package replay, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history check, official export integrity and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replays pass.
- Five additional local boundary checks reject a typed receipt alteration, proof-byte drift, rank and inverse-sign implementation mutants, and output overwrite. The registered verifier also has five mathematical boundary controls and four invalid-input controls.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/dn-bipartite-basis-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/dn-bipartite-basis-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dn-bipartite-basis-floor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/dn-bipartite-basis-floor --check-source-history
```

Expected markers: `PASS_DN_BIPARTITE_BASIS_FLOOR`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The generated RESULT.json binds all six local proof/code/metadata files by SHA256. Source provenance is pinned to canonical main `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13`, priority revision 7. The exact publication head is `e2adbcd3ea362cf3da3548c6982af1c8ce17915e`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The all-size claim rests on the written proof. General bases, changing-split shear products, single-sign punctures, extra factor terms and factors outside the root code are outside scope. The coefficient field here is rational; no characteristic-two claim is made. Physical producer/consumer, frames, dirty restoration, storage, precision, native implementation, compiler and outer recovery remain unrun and unpriced. No complete multiplication theorem, new kappa or selected-frontier change is supplied. The physical rank-shape card's construction gate is not claimed; TASK.json records the changed algebraic scope.

## Open next questions

- Can two shears with changing coordinate splits beat the floor for one paired D5 graph? Begin with an exact complete factorization and one common fitting pairing. A term may lose its coordinate anchor.
- Which single-sign deletions permit a saving over the coordinate value 2e? Begin with a complete decoder and literal common-pairing bill. A cheap isolated term does not establish a gain.

## Related open work

- #3045: proves the stronger arbitrary-basis floor for full D4 and leaves broader D6 global-pairing coupling open. This result covers arbitrary paired punctures and dimensions only within fixed-split bases.
- #2832: develops broader decoder, realization and batching reductions and cites the fixed-dense Dn floor; this package addresses a separate variable-pairing paired-puncture basis question.
